strategy.primary: Xander trigger multiplication: reanimate or cheat out a seven-mana commander (Entomb + Reanimate/Animate Dead/Persist/Feign Death), copy him (Phantasmal Image, Spark Double, Sakashima, Blade of Selves, Helm of the Host, Hall of Echoes, Auton Soldier) and stack his discard-half, mill-half and sacrifice-half triggers.
strategy.secondary: Finish the mill with Bruvac, Riverchurn Monument, Fraying Sanity or Maddening Cacophony; compact backups are Duskmantle Guildmage + Mindcrank, Sword of Feast and Famine + Aggravated Assault, and Breach lines.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Lord Xander, the Collector
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
When Lord Xander enters, target opponent discards half the cards in their hand, rounded down.
Whenever Lord Xander attacks, defending player mills half their library, rounded down.
When Lord Xander dies, target opponent sacrifices half the nonland permanents they control of their choice, rounded down.

identity.why: Discard half, mill half, sacrifice half.
Doubles Xander's mill into a full library.
Two-mana Xander copy: ETB plus a legend-rule death.
Myriad Xander tokens: enter and dies triggers per opponent.
Draws off the cards Xander milled.
